mapper.select: select last_event_seq from aden_workspace where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and workspace_status='ACTIVE' for update

select workspace_id,inbox_id,producer_id,operation,idempotency_key,request_hash,inbox_state,response_json,in_progress_until,retention_until,created_at from aden_inbox where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and consumer='ADEN_RUNNER_CLAIM' and producer_id=#{sessionId} and operation='CLAIM_DELIVERIES' and idempotency_key=#{key} for update
mapper.update: update aden_inbox set inbox_state='COMPLETED',response_status=200,response_json=#{response},in_progress_until=null,completed_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and inbox_id=#{inboxId} and inbox_state='IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.select: select s.workspace_id,s.session_id,s.runner_id,s.session_status,s.session_epoch,s.capacity,s.in_flight,s.expires_at,s.version,r.current_session_epoch runner_current_session_epoch,utc_timestamp(6) database_now from aden_runner_session s join aden_runner r on r.workspace_id=s.workspace_id and r.runner_id=s.runner_id where s.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and s.session_id=#{sessionId} for update

select d.workspace_id,d.delivery_id,d.task_id,d.step_id,d.delivery_state,d.attempt_no,d.required_capability,d.priority,d.task_package_json,d.task_package_hash,d.fence_token,d.version from aden_runner_delivery d join aden_task t on t.workspace_id=d.workspace_id and t.task_id=d.task_id where d.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and d.delivery_state='READY' and d.required_capability=#{capability} and d.available_at<=utc_timestamp(6) and t.task_state in ('QUEUED','RUNNING') order by d.priority,d.delivery_id limit #{limit} for update skip locked
mapper.update: update aden_runner_delivery set delivery_state='LEASED',owner_session_id=#{sessionId},owner_session_epoch=#{sessionEpoch},fence_token=fence_token+1,lease_until=timestampadd(second,#{leaseTtlSeconds},utc_timestamp(6)),version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and delivery_state='READY' and version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select workspace_id,delivery_id,task_id,step_id,delivery_state,attempt_no,required_capability,priority,task_package_json,task_package_hash,owner_session_id,owner_session_epoch,fence_token,lease_until,version from aden_runner_delivery where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and delivery_state='LEASED' and owner_session_id=#{sessionId} and owner_session_epoch=#{sessionEpoch}
mapper.update: update aden_runner_session set in_flight=in_flight+#{count},version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and session_id=#{sessionId} and session_status='ACTIVE' and session_epoch=#{sessionEpoch} and version=#{expectedVersion} and in_flight+#{count}<=capacity
mapper.select: select count(*) from aden_runner_delivery where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and delivery_state in ('LEASED','RUNNING') and owner_session_id=#{sessionId} and owner_session_epoch=#{sessionEpoch} and fence_token=#{fence} and lease_until>utc_timestamp(6)
mapper.update: update aden_runner_session set heartbeat_sequence=#{sequence},heartbeat_at=utc_timestamp(6),expires_at=timestampadd(second,#{sessionTtlSeconds},utc_timestamp(6)),version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and session_id=#{sessionId} and session_status='ACTIVE' and session_epoch=#{sessionEpoch} and heartbeat_sequence=#{sequence}-1 and version=#{expectedVersion} and expires_at>utc_timestamp(6)
mapper.select: select delivery_id from aden_runner_delivery where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and owner_session_id=#{sessionId} and owner_session_epoch=#{sessionEpoch} and delivery_state in ('LEASED','RUNNING') and cancel_requested_at is not null and delivery_id in #{deliveryId} order by delivery_id
mapper.update: update aden_runner_delivery set heartbeat_sequence=#{sequence},lease_until=timestampadd(second,#{leaseTtlSeconds},utc_timestamp(6)),version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and delivery_state in ('LEASED','RUNNING') and owner_session_id=#{sessionId} and owner_session_epoch=#{sessionEpoch} and fence_token=#{fence} and heartbeat_sequence=#{sequence}-1 and lease_until>utc_timestamp(6)
mapper.select: select workspace_id,delivery_id,task_id,step_id,delivery_state,attempt_no,required_capability,priority,task_package_json,task_package_hash,owner_session_id,owner_session_epoch,fence_token,heartbeat_sequence,latest_receipt_sequence,lease_until,cancel_requested_at,version,utc_timestamp(6) database_now from aden_runner_delivery where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and owner_session_id=#{sessionId} and owner_session_epoch=#{sessionEpoch} and fence_token=#{fence}

select workspace_id,inbox_id,producer_id,operation,idempotency_key,request_hash,inbox_state,response_json,in_progress_until,retention_until,created_at from aden_inbox where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and consumer='ADEN_RUNNER_RECEIPT' and producer_id=#{sessionId} and operation='APPLY_RECEIPT' and idempotency_key=#{key} for update
mapper.update: update aden_inbox set inbox_state='COMPLETED',response_status=200,response_json=#{response},in_progress_until=null,completed_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and inbox_id=#{inboxId} and inbox_state='IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.select: select workspace_id,delivery_id,task_id,step_id,delivery_state,attempt_no,required_capability,priority,task_package_json,task_package_hash,fence_token,version from aden_runner_delivery where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId}
select workspace_id,step_id,task_id,step_state,attempt_no,version from aden_task_step where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and step_id=#{stepId} for update

select workspace_id,delivery_id,task_id,step_id,delivery_state,attempt_no,required_capability,priority,task_package_json,task_package_hash,owner_session_id,owner_session_epoch,fence_token,heartbeat_sequence,latest_receipt_sequence,lease_until,cancel_requested_at,version,utc_timestamp(6) database_now from aden_runner_delivery where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId} for update
mapper.update: update aden_runner_delivery set delivery_state=#{nextState},latest_receipt_sequence=#{receiptSequence},outcome_json=#{outcomeJson},error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},started_at=case when #{nextState}='RUNNING' and started_at is null then utc_timestamp(6) else started_at end,completed_at=case when #{nextState} in ('COMPLETED','FAILED_FINAL','CANCELED') then utc_timestamp(6) else completed_at end,version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and delivery_state=#{expectedState} and version=#{expectedVersion}

update aden_runner_delivery set delivery_state='FAILED_RETRYABLE',latest_receipt_sequence=#{receiptSequence},outcome_json=#{outcomeJson},error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},completed_at=utc_timestamp(6),version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and delivery_state='RUNNING' and cancel_requested_at is null and version=#{expectedVersion}

update aden_task_step set step_state=#{nextState},output_json=#{outputJson},error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},started_at=case when #{nextState}='RUNNING' and started_at is null then utc_timestamp(6) else started_at end,finished_at=case when #{nextState} in ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELED') then utc_timestamp(6) else finished_at end,version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and step_id=#{stepId} and step_state=#{expectedState} and version=#{expectedVersion}

update aden_runner_session set in_flight=in_flight-#{count},version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and session_id=#{sessionId} and session_epoch=#{sessionEpoch} and in_flight>=#{count}
mapper.select: select d.workspace_id,d.delivery_id,d.task_id,d.step_id,d.owner_session_id,d.owner_session_epoch,s.runner_id from aden_runner_delivery d join aden_runner_session s on s.workspace_id=d.workspace_id and s.session_id=d.owner_session_id where d.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and d.delivery_state in ('LEASED','RUNNING') and d.lease_until<=utc_timestamp(6) order by d.task_id,d.step_id,d.delivery_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update aden_runner_delivery set delivery_state='READY',owner_session_id=null,owner_session_epoch=null,lease_until=null,version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and delivery_state='LEASED' and lease_until<=utc_timestamp(6) and cancel_requested_at is null and version=#{expectedVersion}

update aden_runner_delivery set delivery_state='OUTCOME_UNKNOWN',completed_at=utc_timestamp(6),error_code='ADEN_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN',error_message='租约过期且取消或执行结果不可权威确认',version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and delivery_state in ('LEASED','RUNNING') and lease_until<=utc_timestamp(6) and version=#{expectedVersion}

update aden_runner_delivery set delivery_state='FAILED_RETRYABLE',completed_at=utc_timestamp(6),error_code='ADEN_LEASE_EXPIRED',error_message='合成执行租约过期，创建下一尝试',version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and delivery_state='RUNNING' and lease_until<=utc_timestamp(6) and cancel_requested_at is null and version=#{expectedVersion}

update aden_task_step set step_state=#{nextState},error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=case when #{errorCode} is null then null else 'Runner lease 恢复协调器更新' end,version=version+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(6) where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and step_id=#{stepId} and version=#{expectedVersion}
